buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. The detailed terms, eligibility, technical evaluation criteria, scope of work and contract conditions are given in the Buyer uploaded ATC document (RFP No. PROJ-201/328/2026-SUDA (T M P F) SECTION / 5 19450-5 dated 29/10/2026). Bidders shall read it in full before bidding. 2. Scope of work: Social Audit of 45 Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) under PMAY-U 2.0 over 5 years (9 ULBs p er year), as per Section 5 (Terms of Reference) of the RFP and the MoHUA Social Audit Guidelines. 3. Eligibility: as per “Procedure for Detailed evaluation of technical qualifications” in Section 2 (Part III) o f the RFP, including average annual turnover from Social Audit work of at least Rs 10,50,000 in FY 202 3-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26, registration for at least 5 years, and experience of assignments commen ced within the last 7 years. Bidders shall upload all supporting documents (CA turnover certificate, re gistration certificate, client certificates / work orders) along with the technical bid. 4. Bidders shall upload Forms Tech-1 to Tech-10 (Section 3 of the RFP), CVs of the minimum team (Seni or Social Development Specialist / Team Leader and Social Development Specialist) as per Section 2 ( Part III), the authority letter / power of attorney of the signatory, and a scanned copy of the EMD. 5. Technical evaluation shall be on a qualify / not-qualify basis as per Clause 15 of Section 2 (Part I) and the eligibility criteria in Section 2 (Part III) of the RFP. Financial bids of only technically qualified bidder s shall be opened on GeM. Selection shall be by Least Cost Based Selection (L1) among technically qu alified bidders. 6. The price quoted on GeM shall be the total fee for the complete assignment (5 yearly Social Audit cyc les covering 45 ULBs), inclusive of all taxes including GST. The fee shall not exceed Rs 7,00,000 per y ear and Rs 35,00,000 in total (Form FIN-1 of the RFP); bids above this ceiling shall be rejected. Condit ional bids shall be rejected. 7. Bidders shall upload the filled Form Fin-1 only under “Financial Document Indicating Price Break-up”, and not in the technical bid. Any price disclosed in the technical bid shall lead to rejection. In case of mismatch, the price quoted on the GeM portal shall prevail. 8. The price shall be quoted only on the GeM portal. Any price disclosed in the technical bid shall lead to rejection of the bid. 9. Payment shall be made for each yearly Social Audit cycle at one-fifth of the quoted total fee: 50% on submission of the Draft Social Audit Report and 50% on submission of the Final Social Audit Report, as per Section 5 (Payment Schedule) of the RFP. 10. EMD of Rs 1,00,000 shall be submitted as an FDR or Bank Guarantee of a Scheduled Bank in favour of the Chief Executive Officer, State Urban Development Agency, Chhattisgarh, valid for 225 days from the bid due date (Clause 12 and Annexure F of the RFP). Bids without valid EMD shall be rejected, no exemption from EMD shall be provided to anyone. 11. Only the original EMD instrument (where applicable) shall be sent by Registered / Speed Post in a sea led envelope to CEO, SUDA, Block-D, 4th Floor, Indravati Bhavan (HOD Building), Nava Raipur Atal Na gar – 492002, to reach by 01/12/2026, 17:00 hrs. Personal delivery shall not be accepted. All other do

cuments shall be submitted online on GeM only. 12. Technical evaluation shall begin after receipt of the original EMD instruments on 01/12/2026, 17:00 h rs. 13. Joint ventures, consortiums and associations of firms are not allowed (Clause 3.1 of Section 2, Part I of the RFP). 14. Conflict of interest, as defined in Clause 5 of Section 2 (Part I) of the RFP, shall lead to disqualification. 15. SUDA may call for and verify the originals of any document from the L1 bidder before award. If any d ocument is found false or misleading, the bid shall be rejected, the EMD forfeited, and action taken as per law. 16. The successful bidder shall submit ePBG of 5% of contract value, valid for the contract period plus 6 months, and sign the contract within 15 days of issue of the Letter of Intent / GeM contract (Clause 17 .2 of the RFP). 17. Personnel named in the bid shall not ordinarily be changed. Any replacement other than in the excep tional circumstances stated in the RFP shall attract a penalty of Rs 5,000 per replacement (Clause 4.4 of the General Conditions of Contract). 18. Bids shall remain valid for 180 days from the bid end date. 19. Disputes not settled amicably shall be referred to arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Ac t, 1996, as per Clause 8 of the General Conditions of Contract in the RFP. 2.
